summary.zh: 支持本地目录镜像、WebDAV 与 Git 仓库的多端增量同步
summary.en: Incremental notebook sync via local mirror, WebDAV, and Git

storage.zh: 保存各笔记本的同步配置、同步状态元信息与近期同步日志
storage.en: Save per-notebook sync settings, sync state metadata, and recent logs

notes:read.zh: 读取待同步笔记与附件内容，用于增量比对与上传
notes:read.en: Read notes and attachments for incremental comparison and upload

notes:write.zh: 将远端拉取的新增或更新笔记、冲突副本写入本地工作区
notes:write.en: Write remote note updates and conflict copies into the local workspace

network.zh: 连接 WebDAV 服务器或远程 Git 仓库执行双向同步
network.en: Connect to WebDAV servers or remote Git repositories for sync

events:note_saved.zh: 在笔记保存后自动触发增量同步
events:note_saved.en: Automatically trigger incremental sync when a note is saved

summary.zh: 官方全扩展点示范插件：覆盖顶栏、侧栏、文件树角标、编辑区背景、面板、菜单、状态栏与弹窗
summary.en: Official kitchen-sink demo covering titlebar, sidebar sections, file badges, editor backdrops, panels, menus, status bar, and dialogs

storage.zh: 保存拉屎风格、背景参数、笔记本白名单与战况记录。
storage.en: Save style preferences, backdrop settings, notebook allowlist, and drop history.

notes:read.zh: 扫描笔记中的标记数量、展示统计并支持点击列表打开对应笔记。
notes:read.en: Scan notes for drop markers, compute stats, and jump to notes from lists.

notes:write.zh: 向笔记写入可识别标记并在冲水时精确清理插件留下的标记行。
notes:write.en: Insert identifiable drop markers into notes and cleanly remove them on flush.

events:note_saved.zh: 保存笔记后自动重算该页标记数并刷新文件树角标与状态栏。
events:note_saved.en: Recount drop markers after note saves and refresh file badges and status bar.

ui:titlebar.zh: 在顶栏挂载面板、快捷拉一坨与冲水按钮，并动态展示数量角标。
ui:titlebar.en: Mount panel, quick-drop, and flush buttons in the titlebar with live badges.

ui:settings.zh: 在「外观」内置设置页末尾追加编辑区矢量背景与夜光快捷设置卡片。
ui:settings.en: Embed quick backdrop and dark-glow controls inside Appearance settings.

ui:commands.zh: 向命令面板、默认快捷键、页面「…」菜单与编辑器右键菜单注册操作。
ui:commands.en: Register commands, default shortcuts, page menu items, and editor menu items.

ui:panels.zh: 在右侧打开「屎量面板」展示实时统计、战报与快捷操作。
ui:panels.en: Open the right-hand Poop Board side panel for live metrics and actions.

ui:status.zh: 在底部状态栏展示带图标的当前总数，点击可一键切换右侧面板。
ui:status.en: Display a live icon counter in the bottom status bar to toggle the board.

ui:notify.zh: 弹出四类语气带图标轻提示，并在冲水前打开二次确认弹窗。
ui:notify.en: Show icon-bearing toasts across all tones and open a flush confirmation dialog.

ui:sidebar.zh: 在左侧栏挂载「今日屎迹」分区、文件树行尾角标与笔记右键菜单。
ui:sidebar.en: Add Today's Drops sidebar section, file-tree row badges, and tree context actions.

ui:appearance.zh: 在编辑区背景层绘制可调图案、密度与暗色夜光效果的矢量水印。
ui:appearance.en: Render configurable vector patterns, watermarks, and dark-glow editor backdrops.

editor:read.zh: 读取当前编辑器选中文本，以便将其包装成带附言的标记块。
editor:read.en: Read the active editor selection to wrap selected text into a marked block.

editor:write.zh: 在当前光标处插入标记块，或直接替换选中的正文内容。
editor:write.en: Insert marked blocks at the caret or replace the active editor selection.

events:workspace.zh: 监听笔记切换、深浅色主题与语言变化事件并同步界面状态。
events:workspace.en: React to note open, theme change, and locale change workspace events.

summary.zh: 支持 Cloudflare R2、S3 兼容存储与 GitHub 仓库的笔记图片自动上传
summary.en: Upload local note images to Cloudflare R2, S3-compatible storage, or GitHub

storage.zh: 保存图床服务商凭证、命名规则与上传记录
storage.en: Save image host credentials, naming rules, and upload logs

notes:read.zh: 读取笔记正文与本地图片引用，筛选需要上传的图片
notes:read.en: Read note content and local image links to find images to upload

notes:write.zh: 图片上传成功后将笔记中的本地路径替换为远程图床链接
notes:write.en: Replace local image paths with uploaded remote URLs in notes

network.zh: 向 Cloudflare R2、S3 兼容存储或 GitHub 仓库上传图片
network.en: Upload images to Cloudflare R2, S3-compatible storage, or GitHub

events:note_saved.zh: 在保存笔记时自动检测并上传其中的本地图片
events:note_saved.en: Automatically detect and upload local images when a note is saved

summary.zh: 从 Obsidian、Notion 与语雀导出目录或 ZIP 包迁移笔记，自动清洗语法并拷贝附件
summary.en: Migrate notes from Obsidian, Notion, and Yuque folders or ZIP archives with syntax cleanup and asset copy

storage.zh: 保存导入配置偏好、迁移统计与历史记录
storage.en: Save import preferences, migration statistics, and history

notes:read.zh: 检查目标工作区现有笔记路径，避免导入时意外覆盖
notes:read.en: Check existing note paths in the workspace to avoid unintended overwrites

notes:write.zh: 将转换后的 Markdown 笔记及附件写入当前工作区
notes:write.en: Write converted Markdown notes and attachments into the workspace

summary.zh: 为笔记铺上与行高对齐的点阵或方格，增加对比度，稳定追踪每一行
summary.en: Line-aligned dot or grid background for notes, adding contrast to track each line

storage.zh: 保存背景样式、对比度与对齐方式设置
storage.en: Save editor background style, contrast, and alignment preferences

ui:settings.zh: 在外观设置中应用并切换编辑器点阵或方格背景
ui:settings.en: Apply and toggle editor dot or grid backgrounds in Appearance settings

summary.zh: 自定义顶栏右上角显示的图标，隐藏不需要的按钮
summary.en: Choose which icons appear in the top-right titlebar

storage.zh: 保存已隐藏的顶栏图标列表配置
storage.en: Save the list of hidden titlebar icons

ui:titlebar.zh: 读取顶栏图标项并控制各个按钮的显示与隐藏
ui:titlebar.en: Read titlebar items and control visibility of individual buttons

ui:settings.zh: 在「设置 → 外观」中嵌入顶栏图标管理区块并同步刷新
ui:settings.en: Embed titlebar icon settings under Appearance and refresh the UI

summary.zh: 午夜铜版塔罗皮肤与写作仪式：牌桌三张牌阵、每日一牌反问、大阿卡纳牌册与速记换肤
summary.en: Midnight Copperplate tarot skin and writing rituals: 3-card spread, daily card reflection, 22 Major Arcana deck, and Quick Note skin

storage.zh: 保存塔罗模式开关偏好，在重启后恢复状态
storage.en: Save Tarot Mode toggle preference across restarts

ui:titlebar.zh: 在顶栏挂载塔罗模式月亮快捷切换按钮
ui:titlebar.en: Show the Tarot Mode moon toggle button in the titlebar

ui:settings.zh: 在外观设置中切换塔罗皮肤及进入牌桌、每日一牌与牌册房间
ui:settings.en: Toggle Tarot skin in Appearance settings and open tarot ritual rooms

ui:commands.zh: 向命令面板注册切换塔罗模式与打开各仪式房间的快捷命令
ui:commands.en: Register command palette actions for Tarot Mode and ritual rooms

ui:notify.zh: 切换塔罗模式或进入仪式房间时显示状态提示
ui:notify.en: Show status feedback when toggling Tarot Mode or opening ritual rooms

events:workspace.zh: 监听语言与主题切换事件，同步更新顶栏按钮与界面状态
events:workspace.en: Listen to locale and theme change events to sync button and UI state

summary.zh: 支持本地目录镜像、WebDAV 与 Git 仓库的多端增量同步
summary.en: Incremental notebook sync via local mirror, WebDAV, and Git

storage.zh: 保存各笔记本的同步配置、同步状态元信息与近期同步日志
storage.en: Save per-notebook sync settings, sync state metadata, and recent logs

notes:read.zh: 读取待同步笔记与附件内容，用于增量比对与上传
notes:read.en: Read notes and attachments for incremental comparison and upload

notes:write.zh: 将远端拉取的新增或更新笔记、冲突副本写入本地工作区
notes:write.en: Write remote note updates and conflict copies into the local workspace

network.zh: 连接 WebDAV 服务器或远程 Git 仓库执行双向同步
network.en: Connect to WebDAV servers or remote Git repositories for sync

events:note_saved.zh: 在笔记保存后自动触发增量同步
events:note_saved.en: Automatically trigger incremental sync when a note is saved

system:notify.zh: 同步失败、发生冲突或需要确认时发出通知
system:notify.en: Notify you when sync fails, encounters conflicts, or needs confirmation

system:secrets.zh: 将 Git 令牌和 WebDAV 密码保存在系统凭据库中
system:secrets.en: Store Git tokens and WebDAV passwords in the system credential store

events:system.zh: 系统唤醒或恢复联网后按现有规则补做自动同步
events:system.en: Resume automatic sync after waking or reconnecting, using the existing sync rules
